target.definition: Total container volume in TEUs (loaded and empty imports and exports combined) handled by the Port of Los Angeles in September 2026, as first reported in its monthly cargo news release.

inputs.name: annual_teu_2025
inputs.description: Total TEUs handled by Port of Los Angeles in calendar year 2025

provenance.rationale: Recent annual volumes have been roughly 8.5-10.5 million TEUs; 2025 likely near 9.5 million.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual TEU volume handled in September

provenance.rationale: September is near average but slightly elevated ahead of holidays; roughly 1/12 with seasonal variation.

inputs.name: daily_teu_capacity
inputs.description: Average daily TEU throughput capacity of the port

provenance.rationale: Annual volume divided by 365 gives ~26,000 TEU/day; capacity somewhat higher.

inputs.name: utilization_rate
inputs.description: Average utilization of daily capacity in September

provenance.rationale: Ports typically operate near but below capacity; September is busy but not peak.

inputs.name: us_annual_teu_2025
inputs.description: Total TEUs handled by all US container ports in 2025

provenance.rationale: US container imports plus exports roughly 55-65 million TEUs annually.

inputs.name: la_share_of_us_teu
inputs.description: Port of Los Angeles share of total US container TEU volume

provenance.rationale: LA has historically handled about 15-18% of US container volume.

inputs.name: september_share_of_us_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual US TEU volume handled in September

provenance.rationale: September is roughly average for US container volumes.

paths.description: Allocate annual LA volume to September using seasonal share
Daily capacity times days times utilization
Scale from US total using LA share and September share
